instruction: Please switch to Yandex as the default search engine in my browser settings.

metadata.explanation: Variation 8: Change default search engine to Yandex. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator verifies search engine is set to 'Yandex'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric correctly performs exact match comparison (match_in_list checks if result in expected list)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is up-to-date before verification
Expected value 'Yandex' matches the standard short_name Chrome stores for Yandex search engine
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement (default search engine = Yandex)
Data flow is correct: Preferences file -> JSON parsing -> short_name extraction -> list membership check
